thread:
ryan: I pushed a tiny docs PR to clean up SOC2 audit-log language and add an SDK example + migration note for Dedicated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1023
meera: Thanks. Legal asked we avoid 'indefinite' and specify numbers. Can we set default to 90 days and note enterprise extensions up to 7 years?
gina: Ops: also include a short migration step for Dedicated customers who used the old retention flag in the ops console. Suggest linking to /dedicated/migration/retention.md and a one-line command to export old configs.
ryan: Added: "Default retention: 90 days. Enterprise customers may request extended retention (up to 7 years) via contract." Also added a migration note and a CLI example: 
```
# export tenant retention settings
rw-ops export-retention --tenant my-tenant > retention-backup.yaml
```
meera: One more technical correction: change wording from 'we redact all PII before storage' to 'automated PII detection and masking are applied during ingestion; detected PII is masked prior to long-term storage. Transient processing buffers may contain unmasked tokens that are encrypted and access-controlled.'
gina: For Dedicated, mention that customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported and point to /dedicated/kms.md. Also add a short SDK snippet showing how a customer can disable request audit logs for dev: 
```js
// turn off audit logging in dev
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, options: { audit: { enabled: false } } });
```
infra-bot: docs-ci: lint passed for PR #1023  1 warning: missing productArea frontmatter.
doc-bot: Added note to PR thread about legal review required for retention numbers.
ryan: I'll fix the frontmatter and wait for legal sign-off. Thanks both for quick reviews
